capabilities: Share individual notes via anonymized online links
extras: README is a stub; documentation lives at jsp.ellpeck.de.
problem: Sharing a single note publicly in Obsidian normally requires the full Publish service; this gives quick, per-note sharing without publishing a whole site.

requires.name: Just Share Please server (official site or self-hosted)

summary: Share server that publishes individual notes online behind anonymized links, with an option to self-host.
